note: Every artifact Reivesti has certified against, including those whose bytes no longer exist. Git pins the expectation; `df artifacts catalog` reconciles it against the workspace and the durable store. States: DURABLE, EPHEMERAL_ONLY, MISSING_BYTES, REACQUIRABLE (exact bytes gone; the publisher still serves them, proven only by an equal sha256 on re-download), REGENERABLE (derived; rebuildable from a raw artifact), LOST_EXACT_BYTES (gone; the digest remains as evidence of what was certified). certifiedRetrieval, where present, is the certified manifest's retrieval facts: `df artifacts reacquire` restores them with exact bytes, so a replay reproduces the certified digests; without it a reacquisition of exact bytes is a NEW retrieval of those bytes. Status as of 2026-09-29: no production durable store exists (DF-0L production object storage is DEFERRED_INFRA); the DF-0L test store was disposable and died with its container.
